headline: Strong copper profitability drives EBITDA beat; outlook remains positive

highlights: Growth capex remains elevated, with INR 20.7bn spent in Q2; its India FY26–29 outlay is at ~INR 520bn.
Retain BUY and a TP of INR 1,200, basis 6.5x FY28E EV/EBITDA.
Copper shines; aluminium remains resilient Consolidated EBITDA came in at INR 128.3bn (+43.1% YoY/-8.2% QoQ).
Highlights: 1) Aluminium upstream EBITDA stood at INR 59bn, up 69% YoY/ down 2% QoQ.
valuation: Oswego’s normalisation, an USD 350–400mn targeted cost savings, and Bay Minette’s ramp-up may boost earnings further.
Retain BUY and a TP of INR 1,200, basis 6.5x FY28E EV/EBITDA.
Bay Minette remains on track, with its first hot-mill coil production targeted in Q4FY27 and commercial shipments expected from Q1FY28.
watch: Aluminium volumes remained healthy at 341kt, up 2% YoY. 2) Copper emerged as the key earnings driver, with EBITDA surging 163.9% YoY/ 82.2% QoQ to INR 16.7bn and EBITDA/te improved to USD 1,518 (+64% QoQ; +44% YoY), supported by stronger realisations of USD 19,396/e (+12% QoQ; +18% YoY) and improved by-product economics.
INR 775bn in Q1FY27, with net debt/EBITDA at 1.8x; higher working capital, reflecting elevated metal prices, and growth capex remain key monitorable.
